description: Implementer-written labels (an AI assistant, reading title and abstract only) for scripts/prior-art-live-eval.mjs. No independent human labelled these and human labelling is not available. A label judges the CANDIDATE against the CLAIM: close = its stated main finding is essentially the claim; partial = shares the central method or the central domain but not the claim; none = otherwise. Keys are DOI, arXiv id, or title; abstracts are re-fetched at run time and not stored here.
